admitted_measurement.admission_rule: Apply the decision-unit-scope reader's classification to each activity row and retain only point and bound rows.

claim_rule.binding_bound: A bound additionally needs ChEMBL assay_type B and standard_type Kd or Ki; it never licenses an exact binding value.
claim_rule.binding_point: A point additionally needs ChEMBL assay_type B and standard_type Kd or Ki; other point types are not binding measurements.
claim_rule.clinical_outcome: No record in either snapshot licenses this claim.
claim_rule.endpoint_bound: Only a stated bound relation with an endpoint value and unit licenses a bound statement.
claim_rule.endpoint_point: Only a stated equality with an endpoint value and unit licenses a point-value statement.
claim_rule.functional_response: Only a numeric concentration series with at least five values and a stated activation or inhibition response definition licenses a response statement in its assay.
claim_rule.limit_statement: The audit does not turn a measurement into a response or a response into an outcome. A record without a clinical endpoint says nothing about a clinical result.
claim_rule.rule_statement: A point with a stated endpoint type and unit licenses its reported value. A stated relation bound licenses only a bound. A numeric concentration series with a stated response definition licenses an observed response in that assay. A direct binding claim additionally requires a binding assay and Kd or Ki. No record here licenses a clinical outcome.

excluded_by_design: Any prediction of a clinical result.
Any claim that either table licenses a clinical statement.
Selection of a record because it supports a convenient conclusion.

record_kinds.bound: An admitted single endpoint value with a stated type, unit and bound relation, without a numeric response series.
record_kinds.concentration_response_table: An admitted assay row with at least five numeric concentration values and a stated response definition in its assay description.
record_kinds.no_licensed_claim: A retained row that satisfies none of the three field rules above.
record_kinds.point_measurement: An admitted single endpoint value with a stated type, unit and equality relation, without a numeric response series.

unmeasurable_routes.binding_to_response_transfer: The snapshots do not pair a direct binding measurement with a response record for the same entity under a matched experiment.
unmeasurable_routes.clinical_outcome: Neither snapshot carries a clinical endpoint or an outcome observation.
unmeasurable_routes.response_to_clinical_transfer: Neither snapshot links a response record to a clinical outcome record.
